deliverable_checks.item: Regression focus: refusal coverage after the typed question_choices() rewrite
deliverable_checks.notes: See the regression analysis in gate_reason.

gate_reason: The worktree gitdir HEAD (.git/worktrees/r2b-qa2-review/HEAD) is exactly 3ef50f5. The carry-forward file holds one req-qa finding, REQ-QA-001, and it is closed: the doc now matches the diff. Regression check: dropping the question 'type' and 'prompt' checks loses no refusal. Question is a struct with private fields {id, prompt: String, choices: Vec<ChoiceId>}, and Question and CanonicalJudgePayload both use deny_unknown_fields (payload.rs:36-37, 96-98). A 'type' key cannot deserialize, and a missing prompt fails deserialization. The type system therefore rules out both cases the old byte-level checks guarded. The one remaining case, an empty-string prompt, is not required to be refused by anything under docs/ (grep found no such rule). The cases a canonical payload can still trigger all stay covered. No question, and fewer than two distinct choices (including duplicate choices that collapse in the set), are refused in sc-jev check.rs:44-57 and sc-jev-backends validate.rs:77-95. Duplicate question ids are refused at PayloadBundle::encode (payload.rs:166-174). Ids and choices come from the typed map, so malformed ids cannot occur. parse_outcome still refuses a wrong model, wrong shape, answer-id mismatch, a choice outside the criteria, non-numeric confidence or probability, and inexact probability keys (check.rs:159-226). Unit tests exercise each refusal (check.rs:309-387, validate.rs:111-132). The grep for ParsedQuestion|unwrap_or(0)|checked above finds none in the sc-jev and sc-jev-backends sources. The only unwrap_or(0) hits are in sc-agent-http test support, sc-ai cli tests and sc-jev-check extract/command.rs, none of them in the files the assignment named. The developer's claim holds, and I found no lost validation and no regression. I read the code statically and did not run cargo; CI green at 3ef50f5 is taken from the input. I did not re-read wire.rs, backend.rs typed_answers or the BackendSet changes in depth, because they are outside the locked req-qa carry-forward scope. No Blocking findings and no new gates requested.
